key.name: poll-active
key.description: Used while the menu is open or the session is starting, recording, reconnecting or stopping, and while it is paused or stopped when the active window is reported to a session with the at-rest guard.

key.name: poll-idle
key.description: Used while the session is stopped, paused or failed, or the server is not running (stopped or paused use poll-active instead while the active window is reported to a session with the at-rest guard).

key.name: microphone-stable-id
key.description: The chosen microphone's stable id from the server's microphone list (PipeWire node name); it survives reconnects. Empty = none chosen. The microphone is only ever turned on with the chosen one; if it is not connected the microphone stays off.

key.name: microphone-id
key.description: The chosen microphone's opaque id from the server's microphone list. It changes when the device reconnects, so it is only used when no stable id is saved (older servers, or before migration). Empty, or not currently present, = no microphone; there is no fallback to another one.

key.name: microphone-label
key.description: Stored when the microphone is chosen in the menu; shown in messages such as "… is not connected".

key.name: show-mic-indicator
key.summary: Show a microphone icon in the top bar while the microphone is on

key.name: report-active-window
key.summary: Report the focused window to the work session
key.description: Sends the focused window's app id, app name, WM class and title to the loopback work-session server, only while it is recording and offers window activity (--window-activity). Never while paused.

key.name: window-title-excluded-apps
key.summary: Apps whose window titles are never sent
key.description: Desktop app ids (with or without the .desktop suffix, e.g. org.keepassxc.KeePassXC). Their windows are reported with an empty title.

key.name: window-title-rules
key.description: Before a window title is sent, the first rule whose app and pattern match replaces the whole title with its label (an empty label sends an empty title). app: empty for any app, otherwise a desktop app id (with or without .desktop, compared exactly) or a WM class (compared case-insensitively). pattern: a case-insensitive glob over the whole title, * for any text, ? for one character, everything else literal (e.g. *Discord*). Control characters in a pattern count as spaces, as in the title. A pattern of only * and ? needs an app. At most 100 rules, patterns of at most 60 and apps and labels of at most 200 characters. Fail closed: while any entry can't be used (an empty pattern, one of only * and ? with an empty app, a field over its limit, more than 100 rules), every window title is sent empty until it is fixed (a value of another GVariant type, possible through dconf write, is ignored by GSettings and means no rules), and while any rule is set a title over 4096 characters is sent empty. Rules are applied to the full title, before it is shortened. Apps in window-title-excluded-apps are still sent with an empty title. Rules change only the window data the extension sends, not screenshots.

key.name: window-title-ignore-digit-changes
key.summary: Delay title changes that only tick a counter until they settle
key.description: While recording, a title change of the same window that only changes numbers of at most 3 digits (an FPS counter, "(9) Chat" → "(10) Chat", "Issue 123" → "Issue 124") compared with the last report sent is held, and sent once the title has stayed unchanged for 15 seconds; every further change restarts the 15 seconds. So a counter that keeps ticking is not reported while it ticks, and such a change is recorded about 15 seconds late. Longer numbers (a ticket number) are sent as usual. Focus changes, the re-send after a start, resume or reconnect, retries and reports while paused are always sent, and replace a held title.

key.name: pause-reminder-minutes
key.summary: Remind after being paused this long (minutes)
key.description: While the work session stays paused, show a notification after this many minutes and again every this many minutes. Counted from when the extension first saw the pause. 0 = no reminders.

key.name: mic-reminder-minutes
key.summary: Remind to check the microphone after no speech for this long (minutes)
key.description: While the session is recording with the microphone on and the server transcribes audio, show a notification when no speech has been transcribed for this many minutes, and again every this many minutes. Counted from when the extension first saw the microphone on, or the last speech. Transcripts land about one audio segment (default 60 s) after the speech, so a delay of only a minute or two can remind while you are talking. Servers that don't report transcriptions with text, an audio limit reached or failed, and a captured output monitor never remind. 0 = no reminders.

key.name: app-url
key.description: Where the whatdidido app server (the read server that serves /app/) listens, for the menu's Now card, Today bars and links: a loopback http origin such as http://127.0.0.1:18850, nothing else. Empty = find it automatically from the work session's /day redirect. Any other value is treated as invalid: the Now card and Today bars are hidden and the menu says so.
